lab.sectionSubtitle: Digital products demand absolute stability. Complex interactions, rendering limits, and new architecture patterns need robust testing in isolated R&D sprints. What proves itself under load here becomes the reliable standard for future client systems. No playgrounds. Only targeted validation.

fluidGeometry.problem: Abrupt UI state changes disrupt navigation flow, increase cognitive load, and signal poor product quality.
fluidGeometry.approach: Developing interpolated vector paths via Framer Motion & SVG, calculated off the main thread. Rendering stable 60fps animations that adapt to scroll velocity.
fluidGeometry.value: Frictionless visual feedback during critical micro-interactions (e.g., checkout or form validation), indirectly boosting user trust and time-on-site.

audioViz.problem: Web-based dashboards often collapse at the hardware level when rendering extremely dense, reactive data streams (audio, live analytics, tracking).
audioViz.approach: Offloading the render pipeline from the DOM directly to the GPU using WebGL/Canvas API and isolated Web Workers for data processing.
audioViz.value: Resilient architectures for data-heavy B2B interfaces that fluidly display complex live metrics without frame drops, even on low-power devices.

The provider of the pages automatically collects and stores information in server log files (e.g. browser type/version, OS, referrer URL, host name, time, IP address). These data are not combined with other data sources.
The basis for data processing is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.
privacy.cookies:
This website uses strictly necessary cookies only.

This applies in particular to storing the selected language version of the website. This storage is required in order to provide the function requested by the user.

The legal basis is Section 25 (2) TDDDG in conjunction with Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.

No analytics, marketing or tracking cookies are used.
privacy.analytics:
This website uses Vercel Web Analytics, a service provided by Vercel Inc., USA, to evaluate use of the site statistically.

Measurement works without cookies. No information is stored on or read from your device.

The following is recorded per page view: timestamp, the address called up, referring page, filtered query parameters, approximate location (country, region, city), device type, operating system and browser including versions, and the version of the measurement script.

To distinguish visits, a value is derived from the technical details of your request. According to the provider, the data is not associated with any individual or IP address, and the association of a visit is discarded after 24 hours. Recognition over longer periods or across other websites is therefore not possible.

The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest lies in understanding which content is used in order to improve the website.

Further information from the provider: https://vercel.com/docs/analytics/privacy-policy

We additionally use Vercel Speed Insights from the same provider to measure actual loading performance for real visitors. Recorded are the route and address of the page, network speed, browser, device type, operating system, the country as a two-letter code, the measured Web Vitals values including the element they relate to, and the timestamp and version of the measurement script. Here too, according to the provider, measurement takes place without reference to any individual or IP address.

Further information from the provider: https://vercel.com/docs/speed-insights/privacy-policy
privacy.rights: You have the right at any time to free information about your stored personal data, its origin and recipient and the purpose of data processing, and a right to correction, blocking or deletion of this data. For questions you can contact us at any time.

letter.headline: Why I am applying.
paragraphs: as part of my retraining as an IT specialist for application development at Berufsförderungswerk Oberhausen, I will complete a mandatory internship from {start} to {end}. Because it is a mandatory part of the programme, the host company incurs no staffing costs.

For this period I am looking for a company where I can apply my current knowledge in practice, get to know professional development processes and grow technically. I am particularly interested in environments where modern technology, software development and demanding technical systems come together.

Web and software development occupy me well beyond my retraining. In my own projects I work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Next.js, and I care about responsive interfaces, good user experience and a structured, maintainable implementation.

Through my own projects and my self-employed work with NuVio Labs I am used to analysing requirements independently, familiarising myself with new technologies and turning solutions into working software. My completed apprenticeship as an electronics technician for energy and building technology adds a solid technical background.
During the internship I would above all like to learn professional development workflows, contribute to real software projects and expand my knowledge in exchange with experienced developers.
I would be glad to convince you of my motivation in person and to present some of my previous projects. I would very much welcome the opportunity to complete my mandatory internship at your company.
